verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents the core terminal loop. `ardent branch create` makes databases. `--print-url` and `--url-type` (direct, pooled or prisma) give you connection URLs. `ardent branch info --format json` lets you inspect them. Token auth needs no login step, and the CLI remembers your project, connector and branch context, so the dashboard isn't required. However, no dedicated shell or psql subcommand is evidenced: shelling in is only implied by feeding the printed URL to an external client. missing for 10: a documented interactive shell/SQL-console command, a full CLI command reference covering list/delete/connect in depth, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.
